verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of museums, parks, fine dining restaurants and sailing on the Rio de la Plata.
verified_facts.excerpt: Park Tower, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Buenos Aires is walking distance from museums, parks, fine dining restaurants and sailing on the Rio de la Plata.

verified_facts.text: The historic Plaza San Martin is just steps from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: the historic Plaza San Martín, just steps from the hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel is at Avenida Leandro N. Alem 1193 in Buenos Aires.
verified_facts.excerpt: Avenida Leandro N. Alem 1193, Buenos Aires, Argentina, 1001

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Suite occupies the entire 23rd floor of Park Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Occupying the entire 23rd floor of Park Tower, our vast 380-square-meter St. Regis Suite is fit for a king.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Suite has hosted many presidents, royalty and renowned artists.
verified_facts.excerpt: it has been the home away from home for many presidents, royalty, and renowned artists.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Suite has Louis XV French-style decor, English furniture and antiques from Europe and Buenos Aires.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sumptuous Louis XV French-style décor, fine English furniture, and authentic, precious antiques from both Europe and Buenos Aires attest to the general opulence.

verified_facts.text: The Senator Suite and Governor Suite are decorated in English style and have personal terraces with views of Buenos Aires.
verified_facts.excerpt: Decorated in distinguished English style, both our 160-square-meter Senator Suite and 173-square-meter Governor Suite offer breathtaking views of Buenos Aires from their personal terraces.

verified_facts.text: Corner Suites have river or city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Magnificent river or city views are just one of the memorable aspects of our 70-square-meter Corner Suites.

verified_facts.text: Corner Suites are furnished in a German style with light-colored walls and wood furniture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Furnished in a sophisticated German style, the calming light-colored walls are complemented by refined wood furniture.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have crown molding, framed paintings and delicate curtains alongside a flat-screen TV and modern bathroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: Crown molding, framed paintings and delicate curtains juxtapose a flat-screen TV and modern bathroom.

verified_facts.text: Suites include walk-in closets, kitchens and separate living areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our suites include walk-in closets, kitchens & separate living areas.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms and pillowtop mattresses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Refresh yourself in a marble bathroom & sleep soundly on a pillowtop mattress.

verified_facts.text: The suites and rooms are appointed in French Louis XV and English styles with European and Argentine antiques.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 116 suites and rooms are appointed in French Louis XV and English styles with authentic European and Argentine antiques

verified_facts.text: St. Regis Restaurant serves dishes from Patagonian trout to a native viscacha arepa, alongside international offerings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor distinctive dishes, from Patagonian trout to a native viscacha arepa, alongside inspired international offerings.

verified_facts.text: The Lobby Lounge serves crafted cocktails and fine wines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy expertly crafted cocktails, fine wines.

verified_facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours, featuring local flavors made with Argentine ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the convenience of 24-hour in-room dining, featuring exquisite local flavors prepared with the finest Argentine ingredients

verified_facts.text: Park Tower shares an indoor pool, gym and sauna with the Sheraton, a sister hotel at the same address.
verified_facts.excerpt: Park Tower shares amenities like an indoor pool, gym, and sauna with the Sheraton, a sister hotel at the same address

verified_facts.text: The fully equipped gym is at the adjacent Sheraton Buenos Aires Hotel & Convention Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fully equipped gym available at the adjacent Sheraton Buenos Aires Hotel & Convention Center

verified_facts.text: A kids club with a ping-pong table, foosball and arts and crafts is at the sister property.
verified_facts.excerpt: there’s a kids club with a ping-pong table, foosball, and arts and crafts at the sister property

verified_facts.text: Guests in any room category get complimentary pressing of two garment pieces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests in any room category get complimentary pressing of two garment pieces.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near Retiro Train Station and the Rio de la Plata waterfront, with Teatro Colon and the Obelisk a short walk away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Near Retiro Train Station and the Rio de la Plata waterfront, positioned close to the city's historic center with Teatro Colon and the Obelisk a short walk away

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near the cruise terminal.
verified_facts.excerpt: From our hotel near the cruise terminal, explore the distinctive neighborhoods of San Nicolás and Monserrat

verified_facts.text: Park Tower skews adult and business-oriented.
verified_facts.excerpt: However, Park tower skews adult and business-oriented.

verified_facts.text: Venues for meetings and weddings include the hotel's private terrace, with Torre Monumental as the backdrop.
verified_facts.excerpt: Make Torre Monumental the backdrop to meetings & weddings in venues like our hotels private terrace.
